flagged.title: Context: Victorian Duality
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly instructs students that both Part (a) and Part (b) assess AO1 and AO2, whereas Edexcel assesses AO2 exclusively in Part (a) and AO1 exclusively in Part (b), which directly misdirects exam technique and mark allocation.

mark_affecting.quote: Part A requires a 400-word extract analysis, and that's focusing on your AO1 understanding and AO2 language analysis. Then, Part B zooms way out, asking you to explore a theme or a character across the whole novella, again, hitting those AO1 and AO2 marks.

flagged.title: Chapters 9-10: The Revelations
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that Jekyll's final confession is 'literally cut off mid-sentence', which is factually wrong and would penalise a student's textual analysis in a GCSE exam.

mark_affecting.quote: These final words, literally cut off mid-sentence, really highlight the tragic reality here.
